title: ALOHA Lightning: Learning Fast and Precise Manipulation
abstract: arXiv:2611.21919v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Learning from human demonstrations has enabled robots to acquire a wide range of manipulation skills, but learned policies typically execute far slower than ordinary humans. This speed gap is mainly due to lack of an interface for collecting demonstration data at high speed, and the difficulty in training policies that can robustly execute high-speed motions. In this paper, we present ALOHA Lightning (Flash ALOHA), a system for learning fast and precise robotic manipulation. Our system uses kinesthetic teaching to intuitively collect near-human-speed demonstrations on a backdrivable bimanual platform, yielding natural and fast trajectories. We also present a learning pipeline that enables smooth high-speed execution through test-time action smoothing and aligns the visual data distribution between data collection and deployment with masking. translated_title: ALOHA Lightning：学习快速而精准的机器人操作
translated_abstract: 从人类演示中学习使机器人能够掌握广泛的操作技能，但学习到的策略执行速度通常远慢于普通人。这种速度差距主要源于缺乏高速收集演示数据的接口，以及训练能够稳健执行高速动作的策略十分困难。在本文中，我们提出了ALOHA Lightning（闪电ALOHA），一个用于学习快速且精准机器人操作的系统。我们的系统采用动态示教在可反向驱动的双臂平台上直观地收集接近人类速度的演示，从而获得自然且快速的轨迹。我们还提出了一套学习流程，通过测试时动作平滑实现流畅的高速执行，并通过掩码技术对齐数据收集与部署之间的视觉数据分布。在每项任务仅需50条演示的情况下，ALOHA Lightning能够自主完成双臂任务。
tldr: ALOHA Lightning系统通过动态示教高速收集人类演示，并结合测试时动作平滑与掩码视觉对齐的学习流程，实现了快速且精准的双臂机器人操作。
en_tdlr: ALOHA Lightning enables fast and precise bimanual robotic manipulation by collecting near-human-speed demonstrations via kinesthetic teaching and using a learning pipeline with test-time action smoothing and masking-based visual alignment.
